summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py next to print: it joins str(obj) values with sep and makes one print call with emoji, markup, and crop off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, and highlight defaulting to True. Added tests to tests/test_console.py after test_print_style (test_out and aspect-specific test_out_* tests, plus a render hook test). Added a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after logging, and an "Added Console.out" bullet to CHANGELOG.md under 9.0.0. Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per the instructions, so the new tests are unverified.
